_doc: Toolkit settings. Copy to <workspace>/forge/settings.json to override per run (only humans edit it). The quality gates and behavioral evals run in the Jenkins pipeline; this toolkit only imports their verdict (forge gate import).

jenkins._doc: Default location of the pipeline's summary.json for `forge gate import` when none is given, e.g. https://jenkins.example.com/job/hms/lastCompletedBuild/artifact/quality-gates/results/after/summary.json, or a local path to a downloaded copy (works offline and in sandboxes). Credentials come only from JENKINS_USER + JENKINS_TOKEN in the environment.

approvals._doc: true: `forge state approve` asks for the run name on an interactive terminal, so only a human in their own terminal can record an approval. Use it with tools that have no permission prompt, and in unattended sandboxes.

cost._doc: max_tokens: LLM token budget for the plan self-check and pilot projection (0 = none). usd_per_mtok: {"input":..,"output":..,"cache_creation":..,"cache_read":..} to report USD; prices change, so none are hardcoded.
